exposure: Combination of Lignocaine 1.5% 10 ml and Bupivacaine 0.5% 5 ml
outcome: Sensory block (assessed by pin prick sensation using Hollmen scale)
Motor block (assessed by movement of fingers and ankle joint using Hollmen scale)
Absence of side effects or adverse reactions
Patient satisfaction with anaesthetic technique (graded as very satisfied)
Effective and successful technique for perioperative sensory and motor blockade
cohort: The study participants were all patients enrolled for USG guided Popliteal Nerve Block for various foot and ankle surgeries.
finding: Ultrasound-guided popliteal fossa nerve block using a combination of Lignocaine and Bupivacaine is an effective and successful technique for providing perioperative sensory and motor blockade in patients undergoing foot and ankle surgeries, without observed side effects.
